dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Progressive cognitive impairment with associated sleep/mood or coordination symptoms, of undetermined cause

Alternative 1: Depressive or anxiety disorder with cognitive symptoms

Alternative 2: Sleep disorder causing cognitive impairment

Alternative 3: Early neurodegenerative or other structural neurological disease
order_raw:
1. Complete neurological examination, including cranial nerves, strength, sensation, reflexes, coordination, gait, and balance
2. Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA)
3. Orthostatic blood pressure and pulse measurements
4. Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9)
5. Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7)
6. Epworth Sleepiness Scale
7. Complete blood count
8. Comprehensive metabolic panel
9. Serum glucose and hemoglobin A1c
10. Thyroid-stimulating hormone and free thyroxine
11. Serum vitamin B12 and folate
12. Serum calcium, magnesium, and phosphate
13. HIV antigen/antibody test
14. Syphilis serology
15. Urinalysis
16. Urine toxicology screen
17. MRI of the brain without and with contrast
18. Formal neuropsychological assessment
dx: Progressive cognitive impairment with associated sleep/mood or coordination symptoms, of undetermined cause
